requirements.desc: Any instruction-source line changed by this spec that gives the full flow status command must use `sdd-forge flow get status`, not `sdd-forge flow status`.
The CLI must not add or register a `flow status` alias; `sdd-forge flow get status` must continue to dispatch through the existing status command.
`sdd-forge flow status` must exit non-zero and write a correction that includes `sdd-forge flow get status`.
